CustomField.description: Written by: call 1 (Located) and call 2 (Identified). Read by: everything that counts a stage in isolation. EXPLICIT BY RULING, never inferred from whether the parent lookup is null: this build already carries a scar from a state with two physical shapes (the unanswered answer row), and inferring stage from a null lookup rebuilds it. Distinct from AAO_Disposition__c: stage says which call wrote this row, disposition says what call 2 concluded.
